    Colombia won the 2026 U-17 South American Championship, defeating Argentina 4-0 in the final on April 19, 2026, in Paraguay to secure their second title. Goals from Andrés Mosquera and a strong performance led the rout, with Argentina ending with nine players due to late red cards. 
    Key Match Details: 
    • Final Score: Colombia U17 4 - 0 Argentina U17.
    • Date: April 19, 2026.
    • Goal Scorers: Andrés Mosquera (53'), José Escorcia (67', 83'+) and Filipe Chavarria.
    • Tournament: CONMEBOL U-17 Championship (Final). 
    Colombia achieved this victory after defeating Brazil 3-0 in the semifinals. This victory marks a significant milestone for Colombian youth football, marking their second continental title at this level.
